# MONITOR error codes

Self-monitoring. 6 codes: 6 with a description, 0 without. Format and other subsystems: [Error Codes](README.md).

| Code | Severity | Description | Suggested action |
|------|----------|-------------|------------------|
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-001` | warning | Self-monitoring service already running | Stop service before starting again |
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-002` | error | BackgroundJobManager not initialized for self-monitoring | Initialize BackgroundJobManager before starting self-monitoring service |
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-003` | warning | Self-monitoring service thread did not terminate within timeout | Check for deadlocks or long-running operations |
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-004` | error | Self-monitoring scan submission failed | Check logs for details and verify system health |
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-005` | warning | Cannot submit scan job: BackgroundJobManager not available | Ensure BackgroundJobManager is properly initialized |
| `MONITOR-GENERAL-006` | error | Failed to submit self-monitoring scan job | Check BackgroundJobManager status and job queue capacity |
